about: The Wasm boundary's golden vectors (advisor-u7-brief.md C5): every integer little-endian. Inbox record: channel u8 (0 Datagram, 1 Control, 2 FullState), arrival ns u64, length u32, bytes. Outbox record: channel u8 (0 or 1), length u32, bytes. Read by web/test/boundary.test.mjs (the page's packing and the fake core's) and by R3's Rust test (include_str!). arrival_ns is a decimal string: u64 does not fit JSON's safe integers.
